revision: S2/P6: 18HP 4-channel audio mixer (Bread Modular 4mix for Eurorack, no overdrive, AC-coupled inputs). User hand placement (P3, tidied to grid): top line SEND A, SEND B | RETURN A over its level knob | RETURN B over its level knob | MAIN, OUT. Four channel strips below (IN jack on top, SEND A, SEND B, VOL with big-knob space). EXP IN left / EXP OUT right at the top, power bottom right, all on B. THT placed only; SMD parked; not routed. P6: two 10 mm M3 F-F hex standoffs (mount_standoffs, user stock) hold the bottom of the carrier to the panel (replace the P5 printed L brackets).
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The carrier F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer holes at X7.5 and X7.5 + 15 HP (83.7), one pair per rail (case/tools/build_case.py HOLE_X0 7.5, 2 HP spacer pitch: both land on spacers).

main_pcb.note: 90.0 x 110.0 mm, 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end, 0.65 mm inside each panel side. 4 layers (user, 2026-10-22): F.Cu signal (only THT bodies on F, free for long runs) / In1 solid GND plane (no tracks) / In2 +12V power plane (short hops only, must stay one piece) / B.Cu signal + SMD; -12V as Power-class tracks. Held by the nine jack bushings/nuts and the two M3x10 standoffs; pots are soldered only.

columns_note: Four channel columns on a 4HP (20.32 mm) pitch centred on the panel. Rows (P3, user spacing): IN Y47, SEND A Y65.5, SEND B Y84 (18.5 mm pitch), VOL Y106 (22 mm, room for the big VOL knobs). The top line does not use the columns: see top_line.
jack_note: PJ301M-12 rot 0, placed by footprint origin (bushing axis): T pad above, TN/S below; courtyard X +/-4.75, Y -6.25..+7.8.
pot_note: Bread Modular RV09 footprint, user-stock RV09 50k B, no bushing/nut (as modules/32bit). Rotation 0: pins 1-2-3 left to right 7.5 mm below the shaft, CW toward pin 3 (drive). Courtyard about shaft X +/-6.41, Y -5.1..+8.65. The channel VOL pots (RVx01) are the same pot; only the panel space around them is larger (big_knob).
panel_hole_note: Pot hole 7.2 mm = Bread Modular PanelHole_Potentiometer_RV09.

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power, bottom-right side margin right of the CH4 column (pads centre); see power_header
EXP IN (back, no jack), top-left side margin: below SEND A / RETURN A, left of the RETURN A level pot
EXP OUT (back, no jack), top-right side margin: below OUT, right of the MAIN pot

expansion_note: J6 EXP IN (top left) / J7 EXP OUT (top right): 2x3 2.54 mm headers on B (pins 1/3/5 = MAIN, SEND A, SEND B; 2/4/6 = GND), on opposite sides so a short 6-way ribbon joins an expander placed LEFT of the master (expander J7, right edge) to the master J6 (left edge). The master (rightmost) owns the returns and the MAIN knob. A reversed plug only grounds the signals (through the 1k outputs).

power_header.orientation: Vertical, pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom row (as modules/imix and modules/32bit).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin IDC socket (pin 1 aligned) overhangs up over the board inside the rail gap and inside the panel width (X 82.5..90.1). No THT tails under it: the CH4 pot bracket tabs end at X ~81.6.

parking.note: Unplaced SMD parts (B side) packed in columns right of the board (own size + 1.5 mm gap), sorted by reference prefix and number, for group-by-group placement.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/32bit: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear; RV09 pots soldered only. The 10 mm M3 standoffs fill the same 10 mm (carrier F to panel rear).

top_line.note: User hand placement (P3): both sends together at the top left, each return jack with its level knob right below it (13.4 mm down), MAIN knob on the jack row beside OUT. Tidied: positions on a 0.1 mm grid, return A left of return B (the hand move had J3/J4 swapped over the other channel's level knob).

big_knob.note: Front-panel keep-clear circle for a large knob on each channel VOL (up to 18 mm diameter; 2.3 mm between neighbouring VOL knobs on the 20.32 mm pitch, 7 mm to the SEND B knobs). Drawn on Dwgs.User of the carrier and panel; build_layout.py asserts no jack nut, small knob or label box inside any circle and the circles do not overlap.

mount_standoffs.hardware: per standoff: 1 x M3 F-F hex standoff 10 mm (user stock), 2 x M3x6 pan/button head (ISO 7380). Not M3x8: with a 1.6 mm board/panel, two M3x8 would meet inside a through-tapped 10 mm standoff (2 x 6.4 > 10).
mount_standoffs.note: No jacks along the carrier bottom, so two 10 mm M3 F-F hex standoffs (user stock, 2026-10-22; replace the P5 printed L brackets) hold it to the panel there. The carrier F to panel rear stack is 10 mm, so the standoff is coaxial: carrier hole = panel hole. X midway between the CH1/CH2 and CH3/CH4 VOL pots, Y 114 so the panel bolt head clears the 18 mm big-knob circles (1.18 mm) and the rail band, and the hex (corners R 3.18) clears the VOL pot courtyards (0.57 mm) and the board edge (>1 mm). One M3 from the carrier B side, one from the panel front. Carrier footprint MSn: board-only (no symbol, no BOM/CPL), NPTH 3.2, F courtyard = hex circumcircle, B courtyard = bolt head keep-out, 3D model mechanical/standoff-m3x10.step (tools/build_standoff.py).
